question: What is the main goal when designing an operating room?

options.D: To provide space for family visits

explanation: Spot on! Everything in the operating room is carefully set up to keep germs away and stop surgical site infections before they start. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h1)

question: Why is the operating suite usually tucked away from busy hospital hallways?

options.A: To make it easier for visitors to find the waiting room
options.B: To keep noise levels high for equipment testing
options.C: To reduce the risk of spreading contamination into the sterile zone
options.D: To reduce the cost of electricity in public hallways

explanation: You got it! Keeping the theatre far from heavy foot traffic keeps dust, outside germs, and random visitors away from clean areas. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h1)

question: In which hospital zone are people allowed to wear regular street clothes?
explanation: Correct! The unrestricted zone is the welcoming entrance area where street clothes are still fine before you move closer to the clean zones. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h2)

question: What must you wear when stepping into a restricted zone like the actual operating theatre?

options.A: Scrub suit, head cover, mask, and proper footwear
options.B: Street clothes and a disposable paper apron
options.C: A clean laboratory coat over casual clothing
options.D: Gloves and heavy protective boots only

explanation: Well done! Full theatre wear stops hair, skin flakes, and droplets from dropping into the sterile field. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h2)

question: What kind of air pressure is kept inside the operating room to keep outside air from rushing in?
explanation: That's right! Positive pressure gently pushes air outwards whenever the door opens, stopping hallway germs from drifting in. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h3)

question: How do HEPA filters keep a surgical patient safe?

options.A: By cooling down the surgical team during long operations
options.B: By trapping microscopic bacteria, dust, and fungal spores from the air
options.C: By neutralizing toxic cleaning chemicals used on floors
options.D: By increasing the humidity levels inside the room

explanation: Spot on! HEPA filters catch tiny floating germs so the air flowing right over the open wound is super clean. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h3)

question: Which medical gases are usually piped right into the walls of an operating room?

options.D: Oxygen, nitrous oxide, and medical air

explanation: Correct! Wall pipelines supply essential life-support and anesthetic gases directly so the team always has what they need. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h4)

question: Why are OR electrical outlets hooked up to emergency backup generators?

options.A: To provide power for the cleaning staff's vacuum cleaners
options.B: To lower the monthly electricity bill for the hospital
options.C: To prevent life-support and monitoring equipment from shutting down during power failures
options.D: To allow staff to charge personal mobile phones safely

explanation: You nailed it! Power failure in Nigeria or anywhere else shouldn't stop life-support monitors or surgical machines mid-operation. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h4)

question: What is the main reason for using aseptic technique during surgery?

options.A: To reduce the cost of surgical supplies
options.B: To make the surgical room smell clean
options.C: To eliminate all micro-organisms from the surgical field
options.D: To speed up the recovery time after anesthesia

explanation: Great job! Aseptic technique blocks germs and bad bugs from getting into the patient's vulnerable body tissues. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h5)

question: What should a nurse do immediately if they spot a break in sterile technique?

options.A: Report the contamination and replace the compromised item immediately
options.B: Ignore it if nobody else saw it happen
options.C: Wipe the contaminated instrument with an alcohol swab and keep using it
options.D: Wait until the surgery is completely finished before mentioning it

explanation: Spot on! Patient safety comes first always. Never sweep a contamination under the rug—speak up and swap it out right away. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h5)

question: What three things make up the surgical fire triangle?
explanation: Correct! A fire needs a spark (ignition), oxygen (oxidizer), and something to burn (fuel) to start in the theatre. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h6)

question: Which of these is NOT a typical safety hazard inside an operating room?

options.A: Sharps injuries from needles and scalpel blades
options.B: Electrical risks from high-powered surgical equipment
options.C: Chemical exposure from waste anesthetic gases
options.D: High-speed public traffic noise from outside the hospital

explanation: You got it! Operating rooms are quiet and sound-proofed. The real worries inside are things like sharps, chemicals, and electrical hazards. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h6)

question: Where does the circulating nurse work during a surgical procedure?

options.A: Outside the sterile field, managing room coordination and documentation
options.B: Inside the sterile field, handling surgical instruments directly
options.C: In the hospital pharmacy preparing medications
options.D: In the recovery ward away from the surgical suite

explanation: Well done! The circulating nurse stays unscrubbed and moves around outside the sterile zone to coordinate and handle records. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h7)

question: Which of these is a key duty of the scrub nurse during an operation?

options.A: Keeping an accurate count of sponges, needles, and instruments
options.B: Operating the hospital's air conditioning and ventilation system
options.C: Transporting the patient home after discharge
options.D: Administering general anesthesia to the patient

explanation: Spot on! Scrub nurses work closely with the surgeon, keeping strict count so no tools or sponges are left inside the patient. [learn more](GNS123_U5_T1#GNS123_U5_T1_h7)
